title: Working Moms in Real Estate - Motherhood, Marriage & Skincare Tips | Marisa Barrett & Gloria Watson
description:
🎙️ EPISODE 3: Working Moms in Real Estate - Motherhood, Marriage & Skincare Tips | Marisa Barrett & Gloria Watson

Welcome back to Working Moms in Real Estate with Gloria Watson and Marisa Barrett—your go-to podcast for all things motherhood, business, and beauty! In this heartfelt and hilarious episode, Gloria shares her recent married life update, and the duo dives deep into what it really means to balance real estate, raising kids, and keeping your glow up strong in your 40s.

From real estate journeys and beauty hacks to parenting struggles and career pivots, this episode is full of laughs, real talk, and relatable moments for any woman juggling multiple roles.

👩‍👧‍👦 Whether you're a mom, a businesswoman, an investor, or just trying to keep it together—you're in the right place.

✨ What We Cover in This Episode:

Gloria’s name change & new marriage
Real talk about motherhood at every stage
The ups and downs of career shifts
Beauty hacks we swear by (microneedling + skincare secrets!)
Future guests: pediatric ENT, estheticians, lenders & more
Honest reflections on family, faith, and finding your purpose

🙌 This isn’t your typical real estate podcast—we’re building a sisterhood where women can grow, thrive, and laugh together.

🔔 New episodes every Friday! Be sure to subscribe and join the convo.
